ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in government programs, including food stamps and other federal initiatives.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records investigation
questions: What is the scope of fraud in government programs?
How can we improve accountability and transparency?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and mismanagement, which could lead to significant reforms and improvements in government programs. I will analyze data and public records to uncover patterns and connections.
